description: Defines the FloatingRateData class, a data container for floating rate information in the Fineract project, including properties like id, name, rate periods, and interest rate options.

classes.name: FloatingRateData
classes.description: A data class representing floating rate details, including comparison, equality, and hash code methods, as well as a static template method.

methods.name: FloatingRateData
methods.description: Constructor initializing all properties of the floating rate data object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this FloatingRateData instance with another based on id, name, isBaseLendingRate, and isActive.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on id, name, isBaseLendingRate, and isActive.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on id, name, isBaseLendingRate, and isActive.

methods.name: toTemplate
methods.description: Creates a template FloatingRateData object with default values and provided interest rate options.
